evidence: Carries the P2P label and directly modifies block relay and compact block encoding in src/net_processing.cpp, src/net.cpp, and src/blockencodings.cpp.
rationale: Predictively prefilling compact blocks bounded by TCP congestion windows noticeably improves block propagation latency across the network. Author measurements demonstrate that prefilled compact blocks allow nodes to 'reconstruct 89.7% of compact blocks received without a GETBLOCKTXN roundtrip' compared to 56.9% previously, substantially reducing hop-by-hop delay and stale block risk.
